auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Get your Nationalize API key from the account dashboard at https://nationalize.io/login (register at https://nationalize.io/register). Connecting validates the key with one sample name lookup, consuming one name from your quota.

actions.name: predict_nationality
actions.description: Predict ranked country candidates and probabilities for a last name or full name.

name.description: A last name or full name to predict. Full names provide the most accurate predictions.

inputSchema.description: The name to look up in Nationalize.

anyOf.description: The number of data points behind the prediction.

count.description: The number of data points behind the prediction.

probability.description: The probability of this country, between zero and one.

items.description: A candidate country and its probability.

anyOf.description: Country candidates ordered by descending probability; empty or null when unknown.

country.description: Country candidates ordered by descending probability; empty or null when unknown.

outputSchema.description: A name-based nationality prediction from Nationalize.

actions.name: predict_nationality_batch
actions.description: Predict country candidates for up to 100 names in input order. Each name consumes one lookup from the quota.

items.description: A last name or full name to predict. Full names provide the most accurate predictions.

names.description: The names in the desired result order; duplicates are allowed.

inputSchema.description: The names to look up in one Nationalize request.

anyOf.description: The number of data points behind the prediction.

count.description: The number of data points behind the prediction.

probability.description: The probability of this country, between zero and one.

items.description: A candidate country and its probability.

anyOf.description: Country candidates ordered by descending probability; empty or null when unknown.

country.description: Country candidates ordered by descending probability; empty or null when unknown.

items.description: A name-based nationality prediction from Nationalize.

predictions.description: Predictions in the same order as the input names.
